purpose.reader_question: How do the paths and dependencies differ across six possible configurations?
purpose.expected_reading: The grid shows single and serial calls, a gated repair, two parallel fork-and-join designs and gated specialist routing.
purpose.claim: The grid shows single and serial calls, a gated repair, two parallel fork-and-join designs and gated specialist routing.
purpose.scope: Three structural sketches from the simulator and three illustrative candidates. Request settings, source edges and exceptional exits are omitted.
permitted_inferences: Order of operations, branches and message availability shown.
prohibited_inferences: Runtime, cost, defect rate or provider ranking from graph layout.

inputs.source_reference: Solo, serial and parallel draft-merge execution rules.
Section 2 permits other directed configurations with execution guards.

constructions.definition: Directed graph with an explicitly declared node set and directed adjacency.
constructions.method: TikZ graphs declares adjacency over vertices with fixed layout coordinates. The caption defines scope.

encodings.represents: Bold call names identify model operations. Task, Result and Routing rule are boundaries or deterministic steps.
